purpose: After O7 fixed-grammar closure and theorem-accelerated O8/O9, search for geometry-relevant organizational services without manufacturing broad O10+ populations. Separate primitive read/grammar breaks from collective services that may emerge under an unchanged local grammar.
authoritative_basis: graduated O7 v2.7 carrier and transition factorisation
machine-checked abstract GRRL theorem plus historical O7 adapter
O9 bounded existence/repeat sentinel and fixed-grammar stop
source_exclusions: historical cosmology/field theory is not a premise
quarantined Phase9 organizational-function side experiment is not authority
method_order: M1 canonical/inherited carrier and theorem reduction
M5 Local Sufficiency Gate for every positive service witness
M7 Spectroscope recognition only after an exact behavioral hit
M9 seal targeted O10+ probe matrix; do not execute O10

A_primitive_read_break.question: Does an admitted frozen action begin to consult organization that the inherited resource quotient does not contain?
A_primitive_read_break.positive_gate: Exact x,y with equal inherited control quotient and different intrinsic organization plus the same admitted action/context produce different enabledness, Counter multiplicity/label, q-visible successor relation, or finite branch future.
A_primitive_read_break.fixed_GRRL_implication: Under unchanged H9/H10 this cannot appear silently: a positive primitive hidden read is a GRRL reopen/grammar-break event.

B_collective_service.question: Can repeated fixed-grammar recursion yield a new multi-step organizational capability even though no primitive action reads hidden topology?
B_collective_service.positive_gate: An exact observer/action programme over q-visible states and admitted contexts exhibits a depth-dependent capability not reducible to the inherited local service description, with a stored separator and Local Sufficiency certificate.
B_collective_service.note: This lane is intentionally broader than hidden-topology reads. Fixed local rules can have new collective future behavior.

geometry_precondition_candidates: stable neighborhood/coarse adjacency under depth increase
nontrivial scale or path-cost composition law
retained state/history dependence beyond inherited resource state
internal reconfiguration, deletion, rewiring, retagging, copying, multiway action or feedback
local-to-global consistency suitable for a metric/geodesic candidate

promotion_rules.descriptor_only: Never promotes to function or geometry.
promotion_rules.behavioral_service: Requires exact matched intervention or finite-context separator.
promotion_rules.local_sufficiency: Every positive service must identify the weakest depth/local subcarrier and context that still separates it.
promotion_rules.geometry_candidate: Requires at least operational locality/route/scale content plus consistency across composition; graph statistics alone are insufficient.
promotion_rules.geometry: Not earnable by this Phase B audit alone.

stopping_rule: If the fixed grammar remains unchanged and no exact same-grammar collective-service question is presently decided by O7/O8/O9 evidence, report the grammar plateau, mark service emergence OPEN, freeze targeted O10+ probes, and do not run O10.
forbidden_claims: raised O-group is already a new algebraic carrier
